rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=3, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=900, lr=0.0003, unet_c=32, rationale=iter-8 ONE-KNOB: per-domain SmallUNet capacity unet_c 16->32, RE-TESTED under the ANCHORED regime (lr=3e-4, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, grad_clip=1.0 ALL held at the iter-7 winning baseline 0.9562). FAILURE MODE / WHAT WE LEARNED iters 4-7: (a) the per-scan lr lever is LOCALIZED -- lr=3e-4 is the bracketed sweet spot (iter-4 0.9541 beats lr=1e-3 @iter-1 0.9501 above and lr=1e-4 @iter-5 0.9479 below which over-anchors/under-fits). (b) the init-quality lever (warm-start pretrain_epochs) is now DIMINISHING/near-saturated: 3->6 gave +0.0017 (0.9541->0.9558, iter-6) but 6->8 gave only +0.0004 (0.9558->0.9562, iter-7) -- marginal gain/epoch collapsed ~0.00057 to ~0.0002, so pushing pretrain 8->12 would spend the budget on a saturating lever AND breach the 15-min wall (iter-7 noted 6->12 ~19 min). With BOTH lr and init-quality now localized, the prompt's fresh lever is unet_c. HYPOTHESIS (capacity-retest-under-anchor): iter-3 ruled out unet_c 16->32 (0.9508->0.9502, NO gain) but that was at lr=1e-3 -- the OVERFIT regime where every extra per-scan Adam step and every extra parameter let each single GT-free scan overfit its own angular-subset measurements (no early-stop in the per-scan loop). The operating point is now DIFFERENT: lr=3e-4 anchors each per-scan fit near a well-converged 8-epoch warm-start init, so extra capacity may finally be USABLE (express finer per-scan structure) rather than overfitting. If c=32 lifts val above 0.9562, capacity is a live lever once the fit is regularized; if it stays flat/regresses (gain <0.001), it CONFIRMS dual_domain_n2i is converging to its per-image U-Net ceiling (~0.956) on Mayo -- capacity is dead even under the anchor, and the remaining iters document that ceiling. EXACTLY ONE hypothesis knob changes (unet_c 16->32); lr HELD at the iter-4/6/7 winner 3e-4, pretrain HELD at 8, n_iter HELD at 400 (iters 1-2 ruled budget out). WALL <=15 min: c=32 is ~2-3x s/step; iter-3 (c=32, pretrain=3, val_n=4) ran 962s, and pretrain 3->8 adds ~5x58s ~290s of c=32 warm-start, so val_n is dropped 4->3 (-25% of the per-scan loop, established wall-control precedent from iter-2; NOT a hypothesis knob) and outer_wall_s tightened 1500->900 as a HARD per-scene-loop cap to self-truncate <=15 min. grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). DO NOT revert to amortized; per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394).
